_comment: Lao PDR tax templates, keyed by PCG account number rather than by account name.
Account names in ERPNext are company-scoped ('4412 - VAT Output Tax - ABC'), so these
records cannot be plain Frappe fixtures - berp_lao.setup.tax_templates resolves each
account_number against the target company and builds the documents at install time.
VAT 10% - Presidential Decree No. 003/PS, effective 1 May 2024.
WHT     - Law on Income Tax No. 88/NA, gazetted 19 June 2026, in force
1 July 2026, replacing the 2019 Income Tax Law. It raised
& performing arts 10% -> 5%. Cross-checked against PwC Worldwide Tax
Summaries (Lao PDR, reviewed 7 August 2026), whose table still shows
the pre-88/NA rate for consultancy and for artists/athletes - where
the two disagree the dated rows follow 88/NA.
Each withholding category carries a 'rates' list so a statutory rate change is a new
dated row rather than an edit that loses the old rate.

item_tax_templates.title: Lao VAT 10% (ອາກອນ 10%)
item_tax_templates._why: The default treatment. Only needed on a line that must differ from its invoice's header type.

item_tax_templates.title: Lao VAT 0% — Export (ສົ່ງອອກ 0%)
item_tax_templates._why: Zero-rated on an export invoice. On a domestic invoice a 0% line is declared as exempt, not as an export.

item_tax_templates.title: Lao VAT Exempt (ຍົກເວັ້ນ)
item_tax_templates._why: For a line that bears no VAT on an otherwise standard invoice — the case the VAT return could not represent before per-line classification.
